title: Volatility clustering
note: Financial time-series almost always exhibit volatility clustering — high-volatility episodes cluster in time. Aurora's anomaly detector picks out the prints; the regime detector picks out the cluster. Treat vol-cluster signatures as conditional: forecasts are only credible while the cluster persists.

title: Correlation breakdown in stress
note: Cross-asset correlations tighten in active regimes. A 'diversified' portfolio in a calm regime may be effectively concentrated when active conditions arrive. The decision-grade question is not the unconditional correlation but the conditional one — Aurora can compute it from the regimes; ask the copilot.
